queries_run: Advantest competition Teradyne SoC test share AI chip tester alternative 2026
semiconductor test equipment disruption in-system test AI chips ATE technology roadmap 2026 2027

findings.claim: Simply Wall St 看空敘事指出：DfT（可測試性設計）普及可能長期侵蝕 Advantest 核心測試市場，壓縮營收與毛利；屬社群分析觀點，非一手報導
findings.source: Simply Wall St narrative: Semiconductor Fragmentation And Rising Protectionism Will Undermine Long-Term Outlook
findings.excerpt: As DfT adoption grows, Advantest faces long-term erosion of its core market, pressuring both revenue and gross margins.

findings.claim: Advantest 自述 CY2025 SoC 測試機市占約 66%，認為有機會超過 70%，HPC 領域更高
findings.excerpt: On the SoC side, we estimate our CY2025 market share at 66%, and we believe there is a path to achieving a market share of over 70% in the future.

findings.claim: Wing.vc 分析：Teradyne 讓出增量 SoC 份額，轉向系統級測試、光子等；測試程式為主要鎖定，驗證後更換風險趨近零，新進者難快速取代
SEMI 預測 2026 年測試設備銷售成長 31% 至 153 億美元，2028 年達 208 億美元
findings.excerpt: testing equipment surging 31% in 2026 to US$15.3 billion and reaching US$20.8 billion by 2028

substitute_technology.note: 未找到單一明確取代 ATE 的替代技術；僅有 DfT、chiplet 減少升級頻率的社群看空論述，及 ATE 與 SLT 整合趨勢。Wing.vc 條目因無逐字原文，excerpt 為 null；as_of 為估計。Porter 五力為銷售頁，弱證據未採用。

clues.claim: Teradyne 文章描述 ATE 與系統級測試（SLT）整合以服務 AI/HPC 元件
clues.source: Semiconductor Engineering: Semiconductor Test Faces Technology Shifts In The AI Era
